title: Babies' Brain Responses to Strangers
official: The Malleability of Social Group Understanding in Infancy and Early Childhood
summary: Researchers at the Diversity in Development Lab at UC Santa Cruz are investigating how babies' brain activities respond to people from familiar and unfamiliar racial backgrounds.

interventions.name: Infants observing familiar and unfamiliar racial groups

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* typically developing
* age 7 to 12 months
* at least 37 weeks gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* any known developmental delays
* less than 37 weeks gestation
